stories.summary: Seed a run's Jira fixture into the project's configured test Jira project before execution, mark every created issue for the run, validate the fixture before creating anything, and roll back on a mid-seed failure
Resolve fixture aliases to the created issue keys, refuse undefined or forward aliases, and hand the per-run alias map to the skill
Record the configured Jira project's post-run state in run_jira.state_after for fixture assertions and show it on the run report, tolerating an unavailable tracker
Delete only the issues carrying the run's marker when the run reaches a terminal state, show the cleanup, and leave human and other-run issues untouched
Run a nightly sweep that removes leftover marked fixture issues, skips active runs, removes orphans, never selects unmarked issues, and reports the result per project
